messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “ideal” time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, prices, or specific activities—but most travelers find the shoulder seasons of **late spring (April–May)** and **early fall (September–October)** to offer the best balance:

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowds & Prices | Why It’s Great |
|--------|-----------------|-----------------|----------------|
| **Late Spring (Apr‑May)** | Average highs ~78 °F (26 °C), lows ~63 °F (17 °C). Light rain showers, especially early in April. | Fewer tourists than peak summer; hotel rates start to drop. | Mild temperatures, lush landscapes after the rainy season, great for hiking, whale‑watching (still active), and cultural festivals. |
| **Early Fall (Sep‑Oct)** | Average highs ~82 °F (28 °C), lows ~66 °F (19 °C). Rainfall decreases sharply after September. | Post‑summer lull; many families return home, so resorts and flights become cheaper. | Warm seas for snorkeling and surfing, clear skies, and the chance to catch the tail end of the humpback whale migration. |

### Quick Temperature Snapshot (average daily highs)

| Month | Avg High (°F) | Avg Low (°F) |
|-------|---------------|--------------|
| Jan | 77 | 61 |
| Feb | 78 | 62 |
| Mar | 79 | 64 |
| Apr | 81 | 65 |
| May | 83 | 67 |
| Jun | 84 | 68 |
| Jul | 85 | 69 |
| Aug | 86 | 70 |
| Sep | 84 | 68 |
| Oct | 82 | 66 |
| Nov | 80 | 64 |
| Dec | 78 | 62 |

*(These averages come from NOAA climate normals for Honolulu.)*

### Bottom Line

- **Best overall**: Late April through early May, and September through early October.  
- **If you want the warmest water**: July–August (but expect higher crowds and prices).  
- **If you’re chasing whale watching**: December–March (though this is the wettest period).  

So, unless you’re specifically hunting for the cheapest airfare or the most vibrant surf conditions, aim for late spring or early fall for comfortable weather, lower costs, and plenty of sunshine.
